[size=5][b]
What is Cinderleaf?[/b][/size]

Cinderleaf is a local-first mod manager for Stardew Valley built for players who want modding to feel easier, clearer, and less chaotic.

It helps you catch downloaded mod archives, review installs before changing files, manage different profiles, check updates, keep backups, compare your real and sandbox setups, and recover safely if something goes wrong.

It is designed as an everyday mod manager first, with safer tools available when you want them.

[b]Who it is for[/b]
[list]
[*]Players who want a smoother install flow
[*]Players who keep different setups for different saves or playstyles
[*]Players who want clearer review and recovery tools
[*]Players who want a safer place to try changes before touching their main setup
[/list]

[size=5][b]
Why people use it[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Watcher-first package intake, so new downloads can be picked up from your folders automatically
[*]A quick [b]Add package[/b] path when you just want to install one archive without extra hassle
[*]Review-before-write installs, so you can check the plan before anything changes
[*]Dependency checks during install planning, so missing required dependencies are caught earlier
[*]Smarter profile enabling, including auto-adding already installed dependencies when that is safe
[*]A sandbox setup for safer testing before moving changes into your real setup
[*]Read-only Compare for checking drift between real and sandbox without turning Compare into a write surface
[*]History tools for archived copies and install rollback in one place
[*]SMAPI helpers for logs and troubleshooting
[/list]

[size=5][b]
Core workspaces[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Library[/b] for scanning installed mods, checking updates, managing profiles, and launching the game
[*][b]Packages[/b] for watched downloads, queueing archives, and preparing installs
[*][b]Install[/b] for review-first install planning before files are written
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] for log checks and troubleshooting helpers
[*][b]Compare[/b] for read-only drift review between real and sandbox
[*][b]History[/b] for archived copies and install history in one place
[*][b]Setup[/b] for folders, backups, restore/import tools, and extra configuration
[*][b]Discover[/b] for finding mod pages and source information
[/list]

[size=5][b]
Backup export supports[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Manager state and profiles
[*]Managed mods and config snapshots
[*]Archives
[*]Optional Stardew save files
[/list]

[b]Good to know[/b]
[list]
[*]Exported profile catalogs can be restored/imported through the app
[*]Exported save files are still a manual restore step
[/list]

[size=5][b]
What changed in 1.5.0[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The everyday UI is calmer, cleaner, and easier to scan across the main workspaces
[*]Archive and Recovery are now combined into one [b]History[/b] workspace with [b]Archived copies[/b] and [b]Install history[/b]
[*]Packages is faster to use, with better watcher handoff, a direct [b]Add package[/b] flow, and automatic opening of Install when the next step is obvious
[*]Dependency handling is more visible in the normal flow, instead of being easy to miss
[*]Compare shows more rows at once and wastes less vertical space
[*]PT-BR localization now covers the main app shell and core workflows
[*]Linux portable release lane is now available as an optional experimental package
[*]Linux dark-theme table/header rendering artifacts were fixed for packaged runs
[/list]

[size=5][b]
PT-BR (Português do Brasil)[/b][/size]
[b]Seção para a comunidade brasileira[/b]

Cinderleaf 1.5.0 já inclui localização PT-BR em partes importantes do app, com foco no uso diário.

[b]Cobertura atual em PT-BR inclui:[/b]
[list]
[*]Navegação principal e estrutura dos workspaces
[*]Fluxos de Packages, Install, Compare e History
[*]Mensagens de status e partes de setup/execução
[*]Confirmações e textos-chave de revisão de instalação
[/list]

[b]Objetivo desta fase:[/b]
[list]
[*]Deixar o fluxo de instalar/atualizar mods mais claro para jogadores brasileiros
[*]Reduzir atrito em tarefas do dia a dia sem abrir mão de segurança
[*]Continuar polindo textos dinâmicos onde ainda houver mistura com inglês
[/list]

[b]Quer ajudar no PT-BR?[/b]
[list]
[*]Feedback de tradução é muito bem-vindo
[*]Se encontrar texto confuso ou em inglês, reporte no GitHub com print e contexto
[*]Sugestões de termos mais naturais para a comunidade BR são prioridade
[/list]

[size=5][b]
Platform support[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Windows portable is the main supported release lane
[*]Linux portable is available as an optional experimental lane (validated on Ubuntu 24.04)
[*]Compare is intentionally read-only
[*]Install remains explicit and review-first; Cinderleaf does not silently install behind your back
[/list]
